lifecycle.rule: A search hit can create REOPEN_CANDIDATE only. Exact source and interface verification are required for SOURCE_VERIFIED; READY_FOR_RERANK is still non-executable and only the execution selector may reopen a route.

debts.reason: The paper theorem and conditional receivers are preserved, but the current direct Lean route lacks the fixed-mode eigenvalue remainder and singular closed-interval uniform-stability machinery.

debts.original_requested_object: A direct Satz9/Fuchs fixed-mode quantitative remainder with singular closed-window uniform stability.
debts.downstream_consumer: The Goal 058 G3 central-overlap denominator-floor receiver on the literal regular endpoint branch.

adjudications.scope: Broad-cone scalar Prime-certificate theorem shape with a uniform positive difference against recurrent finite positive cosine sums.
adjudications.downstream_consumer: The retired broad-cone Prime positivity route.
adjudications.dead_reason: An L1 kernel transform decays while a finite positive cosine sum recurrently returns near full mass, forcing the required difference negative.
adjudications.surviving_interface: Compact S1/S2/S3/S4 calculations remain diagnostics only.

adjudications.scope: Uniform positive A3-pd symbol floor on the full dense difference-packet dictionary.
adjudications.downstream_consumer: The retired dense-dictionary A3 coercivity route.
adjudications.dead_reason: Difference packets collapse as their translation tends to zero, so no uniform positive gap exists on the dense dictionary.
adjudications.surviving_interface: The exact packet Rayleigh identity and PSD-pd kernel representation remain useful alternatives.

adjudications.scope: Raw-product point-value contract at the zeta pole in EStarMuntz v1.
adjudications.dead_reason: At the pole the raw product is not the value of its removable continuation, so the old point-value theorem shape is false.
adjudications.surviving_interface: ZetaMellinReg is the consumer-faithful regularized interface.

adjudications.scope: Arbitrary-cofinal theorem shape deriving joint moving-vector, moving-space, window and cutoff control from fixed-vector density alone.
adjudications.dead_reason: Fixed-vector density does not control all simultaneously moving objects; the claimed universal implication is invalid.
adjudications.surviving_interface: A coupled schedule or constructive diagonal remains a useful alternative interface.
